Tajikistan
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Teheran, Iran.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport NО for the purpose of a tourist visit up to 30 days
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Holders of diplomatic and official passports of Bosnia and Herzegovina can obtain a visa upon entering the country, with prior online registration. Registration is done through the following link:
https://qrc.mfa.tj/registration?eventId=96058c1f-cc65-4ed1-b6a9-5c24aa55ed39&quotaId=bbbffd9e-4ae8-45ce-9df3-ad54178312da
Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina who travel to the Republic of Tajikistan with an ordinary (citizen) travel document, for the purpose of a tourist visit, are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for a stay of up to 30 days.
Citizens of the Republic of Tajikistan are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Teheran, Iran.
